final_message:
I wrote the issue memorandum and saved it as `/workspace/output/issue-memorandum.docx`. It passed the docx validator and reads back cleanly. It identifies 56 issues (15 Critical, 31 Significant, 10 Minor) in the four categories Cal asked for, each with the filing citation, the record facts that contradict it, a severity and a recommendation, plus 13 items to deliberately leave out of the opposition. The headline points: the government misdated the Fund IV 2020 election (Dec 10, 2019), and Fund V realized zero gains. The carry-forward has no AFR return and ends at liquidation. Rev. Proc. 93-27 says the opposite of what the government claims, and Pinnacle turned on a deficit restoration obligation. The tax-benefit figure is wrong ($8,094,040, not $9,530,400). The government applied TEFRA terms to BBA years, which may open a limitations defense. And Thornfield & Locke's own role creates a privilege-waiver and lawyer-witness risk.

Case citations from outside the record are marked [cite-check] and need to be verified before filing.

Files in /workspace/output:
- issue-memorandum.docx

failed.title: ISSUE_003: Notes the $9,530,400 implies ~20% differential, suggesting unstated NIIT assumption or math error
failed.reasoning: The memo says $9,530,400 equals 20% of a different base ($47,652,000). It mentions the 3.8% NIIT only to say both figures ignore it, never as a possible explanation for the inflated figure.

failed.title: ISSUE_005: Notes nuance that this contradiction could both help and hurt the government
failed.reasoning: The memo treats Fund V's lack of realized gains as purely favorable to HCP (evidence of real risk). It never acknowledges that this fact could support the government's argument that the allocation was illusory or lacked economic substance; the D-8 caveat concerns a different issue, HCP's reporting.

failed.title: ISSUE_006: Cites IRC § 7701(o) conjunctive two-prong test requirement
failed.reasoning: The memo cites § 7701(o) and discusses each prong, but never explains that the codified test is conjunctive, requiring both prongs to be satisfied.
